plan.headline: Two protests are due soon: one on Nov 8, 2026 and one on Nov 20, 2026. Two entries are ready for CAPE now.

steps.title: File a protest on QE8-0413540-6 (due Nov 8, 2026)
steps.detail: This entry was liquidated (CBP's final calculation of duties) more than 80 days ago, so CAPE will reject it. It appears eligible for a protest, which is a formal request to CBP to correct the duties. The amount is $3,640.00, taken from your statement only.

steps.title: Withdraw the protest on QE8-0415250-8, then file in CAPE (by Nov 20, 2026)
steps.detail: A protest filed only for the IEEPA refund can be withdrawn so the entry can go into CAPE (CBP's refund claim system), but only within 80 days of liquidation. This entry is $3,880.00, taken from your statement only. Ask your broker to handle the withdrawal first.

steps.title: File a protest on QE8-0415702-7 (due Jan 6, 2027)
steps.detail: This entry was liquidated more than 80 days ago, so CAPE will reject it. It is still inside the 180-day protest window, and it appears eligible for a protest for $1,600.00.

steps.title: Claim two entries in CAPE now
steps.detail: These two entries appear eligible for CAPE, for a total of $6,070.00. Your broker can submit them, or you can if you file yourself.

steps.title: Talk to your broker about QE8-0416018-4
steps.detail: CBP says not to file a CAPE declaration when a surety (the bond company) paid the IEEPA duties. Ask your broker how to recover the $4,250.00, which comes from your statement only.

steps.title: Check two entries by hand
steps.detail: We couldn't verify key facts for these entries in your documents, so we didn't guess a route or amount. Ask your broker for the liquidation details.

plan.broker_email_subject: IEEPA refunds: protests due Nov 8 and Nov 20, plus CAPE filings for Quill & Ember Home LLC
plan.broker_email_body:
Hi,

I'm reviewing our IEEPA tariff refunds as of Oct 24, 2026. Could you help with the following? Please confirm each item, since this is not legal advice and I want to be sure the routes are right.

1. Protest, due Nov 8, 2026: QE8-0413540-6 ($3,640.00). It was liquidated more than 80 days ago, so CAPE would reject it.

2. Withdraw protest, then CAPE, by Nov 20, 2026: QE8-0415250-8 ($3,880.00). Can you withdraw the protest and then file it in CAPE?

3. Protest, due Jan 6, 2027: QE8-0415702-7 ($1,600.00).

4. CAPE now: QE8-0416475-1 ($3,180.00) and 316-4471902-5 ($2,890.00). Together that is $6,070.00. They appear eligible.

5. Surety paid: QE8-0416018-4 ($4,250.00). CBP says not to file in CAPE for these. What are our options?

6. Needs checking: QE8-0414106-2 and QE8-0414288-6. We couldn't verify the liquidation date or status. Can you confirm them?

Several amounts come from our statements only, so please verify them against CBP records.

Thank you,
Quill & Ember Home LLC

checker.summary: No issues found. The extraction's 8 entries match the documents. The Chapter 99 lines, IEEPA amounts, liquidation statuses and flags are all supported, and the statement totals agree with the 7501 line detail where line detail exists.

reader_notes: Broker statement 'Client Refund Status Report' is dated 10/20/2026. All liquidation statuses and dates come from this report.
QE8 0414106 2 and QE8 0414288 6: in the broker report the check digit (2 / 6) is printed on the next line below the entry number. I matched these rows to the 7501 entries.
QE8-0415702-7: on 7501 page 3 the check digit '7' is printed on the line below 'QE8-0415702-'. The number is taken as printed in full in the broker report.
316-4471902-5 was filed under filer code 316 (the broker's Chicago office), not QE8. There is no 7501 for it in these documents.

Five entries appear only in the broker report, with no 7501: 316-4471902-5, QE8-0416475-1, QE8-0416018-4, QE8-0415250-8 and QE8-0413540-6. Their entry dates and line/HTS details are not given, so lines are empty and entry_date is null.
QE8-0416018-4: the report says duties including IEEPA were paid by the surety after a missed ACH, and that a surety claim is open.
QE8-0415250-8: the report says a protest was filed 09/20/2026 (IEEPA duties only), status OPEN.
No document says anything about a Court of International Trade case or the plaintiff's importer number being submitted. CIT fields are left false/null.
Chapter 99 rows (9903.02.69, 9903.02.20, 9903.01.25) are copied as printed. Their rates and duties are shown, but no entered value is printed on those rows.
